description: M27 measured baseline for GANGZII local TTS performance — the reference M28 regression comparison runs against. Recorded from scripts/m27-kokoro-smoke.ts and tests/integration/gangzii-audio-worker.e2e.test.ts on the M27 sandbox host (2 vCPU / 3.9 GB RAM). These numbers are MEASURED evidence from the M27 session, not targets.

environment.note: GPU-less CPU host; RTX-class hardware was explicitly NOT assumed in M27 or M28.

realtimeFactor.toleranceNote: RTF within ±0.35 of baseline on comparable hardware is acceptable; higher = regression to flag.

sampleSmoke.text: GANGZII is the audio production specialist of BEAN Intelligence. This narration was synthesized locally on this machine.

qualityGates.note: Subjective quality (pronunciation/intelligibility) has NO automatic baseline: the M27 session did not perform a human listening review. Any listening-review comparison is the owner's; this file only anchors TECHNICAL regressions.
technicalChecks: segment ordering preserved (chunks == expected segment count)
no clipping (peak < -0.1 dBTP) for default-speed narration
output always 24 kHz mono PCM16 WAV
